Pallavi Chatterjee
Senior Frontend Engineer | Hyderabad
pallavi.chatterjee508@example.com | +91 9745450886

Senior frontend engineer focused on building performant, accessible web applications with a strong emphasis on component-driven design and automated testing. Experienced in shipping customer-facing features, improving developer experience, and reducing regressions through unit and integration test suites. Open to roles that leverage strong TypeScript and React expertise.
Notice period: 60 days

Experience
Wipro — Apr 2026 - Present
Senior Frontend Engineer (Remote)
- Led a React and TypeScript rewrite of a legacy customer portal, reducing initial load time by 42% and improving Lighthouse performance score from 58 to 89 by optimizing bundle sizes and code-splitting.
- Implemented component library patterns and Redux data flows to standardize state management across three major product teams, cutting duplicate UI code by 65%.
- Introduced Jest test suites for critical flows, increasing unit test coverage from 18% to 76% and reducing production bugs by 38% in the first two quarters.

Nykaa — Aug 2022 - Mar 2026
UI Engineer (Hybrid)
- Built and maintained high-traffic product listing and PDP pages using React and TypeScript, contributing to a 22% uplift in conversion for promoted categories through A/B-tested UI changes.
- Created reusable CSS modules and design tokens to enforce visual consistency, decreasing UI bug reports by 47% and accelerating feature rollout by 30%.
- Collaborated with QA to author Jest-based unit tests for core components, maintaining a stable regression suite that caught 85% of front-end regressions before release.

UrbanPantry — Feb 2020 - Jul 2022
UI Engineer (Onsite)
- Developed customer-facing order and checkout flows in React and TypeScript, improving checkout completion rate by 15% through performance and UX optimizations.
- Implemented Redux patterns for cart and inventory synchronization, reducing cart-related edge-case incidents by 40%.
- Leveraged Git workflows and code reviews to streamline releases; introduced smoke tests that decreased hotfix frequency by 28%.

Projects
- Component Library: Built a documented React component library with TypeScript typings and Jest tests used across internal apps, reducing new feature development time by ~20%.
- Accessibility Audit: Led an accessibility audit and remediation project across multiple pages, bringing key user journeys to WCAG AA compliance and improving keyboard navigation success metrics.
